capabilities: Render pikchr code blocks as diagrams in Reading view, Live Preview, embeds, Canvas cards and exported PDFs
Toggle individual diagrams between rendered view and source code
Add captions, alignment and alt text per diagram
Adapt diagram colors to dark and light themes
Configure a render time limit and debug logging
extras: Rendering is fully local with no internet connection or data collection; the README defers learning the Pikchr language itself to the external Pikchr user manual.
problem: Obsidian only renders Mermaid code blocks as diagrams, so Pikchr code sits as plain text in notes.

relations.evidence: Diagrams are drawn by Pikchr, created by D. Richard Hipp.

summary: Renders Pikchr code blocks as diagrams in Reading view and Live Preview, with a button to flip each diagram back to its source.
